verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a shared-inbox SaaS like Missive, but the evidence pack documents no first-party bulk export in open formats and no offboarding path. The REST API endpoints and MCP access are developer building blocks someone could use to build an export. Two-way Gmail sync and local attachment downloads are adjacent features. None of these count as the export capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
